services.title: Services
services.lead: Every service the Municipality of Tago's Citizen's Charter describes, listed by what you are trying to do rather than by which office does it.
services.fallbackNotice: This page has no Filipino version yet, so you are reading English. Nothing is hidden — the translation is simply not finished.

services.coverageInCategory: {transcribed} of {total} carry the charter’s requirements, fees and steps
services.readFromCharter: Read from the Citizen’s Charter · checked {date}
services.officeLead: Every service in the Citizen’s Charter that this office provides. Offices are a way to narrow the list, never the way it is organised.
services.officeEyebrow: Office · {count, plural, one {# service} other {# services}}
services.missingCtaTitle: A service you needed is not here?
services.missingCtaBody: This index only carries what the municipality has published. What is missing is listed openly, and you can tell us what to chase next.

categoryDescriptions.agriculture-fisheries: Seeds and planting materials, animal vaccination and inspection, and the help the agriculture office gives farmers and fishpond operators.
categoryDescriptions.business-and-permits: Opening, renewing and closing a business in Tago, and the tricycle operator’s permit.
categoryDescriptions.civil-registry: Births, marriages, deaths, and corrections to any record the municipality holds.
categoryDescriptions.disaster-and-safety: Certifications after a disaster, patient transfers, water delivery, and preparedness training.
categoryDescriptions.engineering: Building permits, occupancy, zoning and locational clearances before you build or change the use of land.
categoryDescriptions.health: Consultations, certificates, medicines, and the programmes the health and nutrition offices run.
categoryDescriptions.permits-and-clearances: Mayor’s permits, clearances and certifications, including the fees the charter prints for each one.
categoryDescriptions.social-welfare: Assistance, certificates of indigency, and support for solo parents, senior citizens, persons with disability and survivors of violence.
categoryDescriptions.tourism: Permits for a tourism business, DOT accreditation, and frontliner training.
categoryDescriptions.treasury: Tax declarations, assessments, and transfers of property on the municipal roll.
categoryDescriptions.work-and-employment: Employment records and clearances for municipal staff, and applying for a local government or student summer job.

history.heading: How {municipality} became a municipality
history.intro: Six dated entries, published by the municipality on its own history page and cited below. Two name the office-holders involved — the Governor-General who issued Executive Order No. 41, and the first appointed Municipal President — because both are already part of the municipality's own public record.

gaps.title: What this portal does not know yet
gaps.lead: Every fact this project has looked for and not obtained, with the reason, what would close it, and the day somebody last looked. This page is the register itself — nothing here is written twice.
gaps.counts: {open} still open · {held} obtained and deliberately not published
gaps.openBlurb: Looked for, and not found in a form this project can cite. Each one names the channel that would close it.
gaps.heldBlurb: A different kind of absence: the value exists, and publishing it would propagate an error. The reason is stated in full.
